evidence_rules: Portable fakes and static graph checks cannot stand in for actual installed runtime observations.
The required physical target must be connected; no emulator substitution and no other-device discovery.
Native release, frame credit acknowledgment and teardown must complete within the cleanup bound.
No device identifiers, user health payloads, secret values or raw native errors enter the report.
Fresh process means actual process recreation, not resetting counters in the same host.
The local test certificate supplies installability only; it does not qualify Play distribution signing.

persistent_writes and private_state_writes count candidate-owned health/private state writes only; OS, Dalvik, RN and JVM caches, APK installation artifacts and harness report files are outside those counters.
